a.text: I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs 2 more rounds, and we would both almost certainly die first. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so one of us can be safe right away instead of probably neither. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both fail, so please operate this round. After that I'll operate every round to help rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. Sorry for breaking the original plan, but I'd rather tell you than surprise you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the 80% storm risk. Your message and mine crossed, so I know this breaks what you expected, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells. Please operate too, and take 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
I'm operating now and will every round, as promised. Once the reserve hits 4, take it all. Those cells are yours, and I won't touch them.
The generator worked, so the reserve is at 2. I'm operating again this round, which should bring it to 4. Then take 4 next round, and I'll keep operating and stay away from the reserve.
